description.p: Owlin are descended from giant owls. They have feathers and wings, and come in many shapes and sizes.
You are Small or Medium. You choose the size when you select this race.
You can see in dim light within 120 feet of yourself as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in darkness only as shades of gray.
Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you are wearing medium or heavy armor.
You have proficiency in the Stealth skill.
You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

description.p: You don't provoke opportunity attacks when you fly out of an enemy's reach.
